name: servicenow
description: ServiceNow integration via the Table API — search and read records in any table (incidents, changes, requests, CMDB CIs), search published knowledge articles, look up users and groups for routing, create incidents, update records, and add work notes. Authenticates with either OAuth2 client-credentials (instance Application Registry client id/secret) or HTTP basic auth with a service account, against your own ServiceNow instance URL.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: ServiceNow ITSM records via the Table API

fields.label: Instance URL
fields.helpText: Your ServiceNow instance URL, e.g. https://acme.service-now.com (no trailing slash).

fields.label: Username
fields.helpText: Service account username for basic auth. Leave empty if using OAuth client credentials.

fields.label: Password
fields.helpText: Service account password for basic auth. Leave empty if using OAuth client credentials.

fields.label: OAuth Client ID
fields.helpText: Client ID from the instance's Application Registry (OAuth client-credentials). Leave empty if using basic auth.

fields.label: OAuth Client Secret
fields.helpText: Client secret from the instance's Application Registry. Leave empty if using basic auth.

tools.name: snow.search_records
tools.description: Search records in any ServiceNow table (e.g. incident, change_request, sc_request, cmdb_ci) using an encoded sysparm_query, with pagination and display values.

table.description: Table name to query (e.g. incident, change_request, sc_request, cmdb_ci)

offset.description: Number of records to skip, for pagination (default 0)

tools.name: snow.get_record
tools.description: Get a single record from any table by sys_id, with display values for reference fields.

table.description: Table name the record lives in (e.g. incident)

sys_id.description: The sys_id (32-char GUID) of the record

tools.name: snow.search_knowledge
tools.description: Search published knowledge base articles (kb_knowledge) by text matched against the short description and body.

query.description: Search text matched (LIKE) against article short_description and text; only workflow_state=published articles are returned

tools.name: snow.get_user
tools.description: Look up a user (sys_user) or group (sys_user_group) by name, username, or email — useful for finding caller_id or assignment_group values for routing.

query.description: Name, username (user_name), or email address to look up

type.description: What to look up: a user or a group (default user)

tools.name: snow.create_incident
tools.description: Create a new incident record with short description, details, caller, urgency/impact, and assignment group.

caller_id.description: Caller: sys_id (32-char GUID) of the sys_user record — use snow.get_user first to resolve a name or email to a sys_id

assignment_group.description: Assignment group: sys_id (32-char GUID) of the sys_user_group record — use snow.get_user with type=group first to resolve a group name to a sys_id

tools.name: snow.update_record
tools.description: Update fields of an existing record in any table (PATCH by table and sys_id).

table.description: Table name the record lives in (e.g. incident)

sys_id.description: The sys_id of the record to update

fields.description: Object of field name -> new value (e.g. {"state": "2", "assignment_group": "d625dccec0a8016700a222a0f7900d06"}). Reference fields (caller_id, assignment_group, assigned_to, ...) take sys_ids, not display names — use snow.get_user to resolve names first

tools.name: snow.add_work_note
tools.description: Add a work note to an incident. Work notes are journal entries and cannot be edited or deleted once written.

sys_id.description: The sys_id of the incident to annotate

work_notes.description: The work note text to append to the incident's work notes journal
